scope: two nodes, one rank and one MI250X GCD per node, one cross-node CXI peer per rank

compiler_transforms.note: candidate generation is enabled here, but the AMDGPU pass must independently reprove unique-loop and unique-flush placement

deployment_constraints.note: proxy producer concurrency is bounded by min(grid_blocks, proxy_worker_lanes); forced IPC is unavailable

evaluation_contract.role: compiler-only capacity experiment; disjoint from frozen evaluation labels
evaluation_contract.execution: each named kernel scenario is timed independently under four compiler-generated plans
evaluation_contract.candidate_budget: one opaque compiler candidate ID per opportunity; no source edits, generated code, generated IR, or model-authored placement

action_notes.proxy: device pushes commands into CPU-worker rings
action_notes.trigger_batch: host stages N descriptors; the source-level device flush triggers them after intervening work
action_notes.coalesce_late: host stages one compiler-coalesced descriptor; the source-level device flush triggers it after intervening work
action_notes.coalesce_early: host stages one compiler-coalesced descriptor; the device pass moves the trigger to the proven communication-loop exit to expose overlap, which may also create resource contention
action_notes.ipc: same-node path only and unavailable under this cross-node placement contract

provenance.dataset: pre-existing compiler-path calibration constants only; no trigger-placement runtime labels
provenance.deployment: one rank per node with GICC_NUM_PROXY_THREADS=8
